title: Space Technology
definition: Space technology encompasses the hardware, software, and operational methodologies used for space exploration, satellite deployment, orbital mechanics, and remote sensing applications. It is a critical enabler of socio-economic development, national security, and scientific discovery.
importanceInUpsc: Space Technology features consistently in UPSC Prelims (satellites, launch vehicles, orbits, international treaties) and Mains GS Paper-3 (Achievements of Indians in science & technology, indigenization of technology, and developing new technology).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Space Technology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
